{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the data types and look for issues
print(sales_df.dtypes)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print('\nSentinel values in customer_age (should be -1):')
print(sales_df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values:')
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check the values in 'channel' and 'customer_segment'
print('\nChannel distribution:')
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print('\nCustomer segment distribution:')
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the revenue column — it's likely a string with commas
print('\nSample of revenue column:')
print(sales_df['revenue'].head())

# Check status
print('\nStatus distribution:')
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())"}
